# opencodecontrols_service_account_api_keys (Data Source)

List the API key metadata returned by OpenCode Console for a service account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opencodecontrols_service_account_api_keys" "example" {
  service_account_id = "svcacct_01AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_account_id` (String) OpenCode Console service account ID, beginning with svcacct_.

### Read-Only

- `keys` (Attributes List) Key metadata, including statuses. Bearer tokens are never returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `expires_at` (String) API key expiration as an RFC3339 timestamp, if set.
- `id` (String) API key ID.
- `name` (String) API key name.
- `permissions` (String) API key permission level.
- `scopes` (Set of String) Assigned permission scopes.
- `status` (String) API key status.
